jcr:content.jcr:title: We underwrite the operator, not the market.

master.title: We underwrite the operator, not the market.
master.statement: Market size is the easiest number to be wrong about and the hardest to be held to. We underwrite the people who will have to sell into it.
master.rationale: A large market with no organised buyer is a forecast. An operator who already knows who signs the cheque is evidence. Where the two disagree we follow the operator.
